text_block_list.text: When I came to the shrine to pray together with Furioso, who has been feeling a bit off lately—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Oh dear me...?
Looks like I've ended up back at the shrine again."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...Acute-san.
Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Furioso-san. I'm actually on my
way to the "Bead Craft Class" today.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: "I tried using a 'digital map', you see, but ended up losing my way entirely."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
A bead craft workshop... That's a lovely hobby.
Very fitting for someone as nimble-fingered as you, Acute-san.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ooh. Furioso-san, are you interested?
In that case—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...What is this?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I made keychains for an assignment, but I have so~ many, so I thought maybe you'd like one.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: So many...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(Ah... this blue one is so cute...
...The pattern even looks like Funabashi's city emblem...)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: (However...)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I think it suits you wonderfully, Furioso-san.
Hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: (...Can this really be a coincidence? Trying to soften me up... but that smile...)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(No! Don't be swayed! Pull yourself together!
Never forget the pride of Funabashi! Furioso!)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"...A-Aha~! Right, I'm sorry.
I wish I could've made something
a bit more stylish for you."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Ah... No!
It's not like that—!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: (Good things are never guilty of any crime!!!)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...... Um, may I please have
one of those blue ones?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Fufufu. My body feels strangely light today.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
It's merely a similar motif.
Even so... it really fires me up.

"The keychain hanging on her training bag.
Thanks to that, she was getting right back in shape."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, huh?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear. It started raining.
Time to retreat~.
Come on, Furioso-san, you hurry up too~.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Ugh... yes...
Furioso was left feeling unsettled. She was unable to get back into top form.
